title: Andrea Ávila Embarks on Book Tour for 'Creativas y Líderes: Cambiando las Reglas del Juego' | User | ridgwayrecord.com
text:
Andrea Ávila, award-winning creative director and advertising strategist, poses ahead of her multi-city book tour for Creativas y Líderes: Cambiando las Reglas del Juego. Her work in branding and multimedia has earned international recognition, shaping the future of creative industries. By: Katlen Giraldo Miami, FL - Award-winning creative director and advertising strategist Andrea Ávila is set to embark on a multi-city book tour to present her latest work, Creativas y Líderes: Cambiando las Reglas del Juego . The tour will kick off in Miami before making stops in New York and Philadelphia, bringing her insights on leadership, innovation, and multimedia storytelling to a broader audience.
Ávila, an Ecuadorian-born art director and strategist, has built an international career at the intersection of advertising, branding, and multimedia content creation. Her work has earned recognition from Forbes, The American Advertising Awards, and the One Club Festival, among others. Now, with Creativas y Líderes , she turns her attention to the evolving landscape of the creative industries, offering a roadmap for professionals looking to break new ground in advertising and multimedia.
The book is inspired by her master’s research at Florida International University, where she conducted in-depth studies on the challenges and opportunities for creatives in advertising. Through interviews with industry leaders and analysis of market trends, Ávila provides insights into what it takes to thrive in today’s fast-paced digital and branding world.
The tour will include a mix of panel discussions, book signings, and interactive workshops, bringing together professionals from advertising, media, and business communities. Attendees can expect thought-provoking conversations on the latest trends in branding, creative strategy, and content marketing.
Tour Dates & Locations:
Miami, FL – March 10, 2025 – Books & Books, Coral Gables New York, NY – March 15, 2025 – The Strand Bookstore Philadelphia, PA – March 20, 2025 – Free Library of Philadelphia
The upcoming book tour is not just about literature—it’s a deep dive into the creative industry. Ávila’s work highlights the need for innovative thinking, strong mentorship programs, and cutting-edge multimedia strategies that redefine advertising and content creation. With her signature blend of research and real-world experience, she continues to be a key voice in the advertising and branding world.
Tickets for the book tour events are free but require advance registration. Follow Andrea Avila her on social media @Andreaavila.
About Andrea Ávila:
Andrea Ávila is an award-winning art director, advertising strategist, and branding expert. She has worked with top agencies in Miami and Ecuador, developing campaigns that blend creativity, storytelling, and cutting-edge multimedia. Her work has been featured in international creative festivals, and she remains a leading figure in the advertising and branding industries. Creativas y Líderes: Cambiando las Reglas del Juego is her first book.
